Diffusion Reaction Equation on Metric Graphs

We solve diffusion reaction equations using either a multigrid method or a PCG method.

Multigrid Setup

Detailed instructions and function references for setting up the multigrid solver manually, including system assembly and hierarchy initialization.

Multigrid on Metric Graphs

Pre-configured example routines demonstrating the multigrid method applied to diffusion-reaction equations on various topologies.

PCG Method

The Preconditioned Conjugate Gradient (PCG) method, utilized as an alternative solver or baseline comparison.
